judge_notes.opus55: An expected guide trim on an ADR that fell after 3 of 4 non-raise guide updates, coming off a 24% sector-driven run-up; the covering short partly offsets.

judge_notes.fable51: A guide trim is the published base case and the ADR fell after 3 of 4 non-raise updates (i0), yet it ran 24% in 20 days on a sector rally not its own numbers (i1); a crowded, covering ADR short (i2) and peers being bought (i4) soften it.
